header.running_head: Leading the Salaah and Following the Imaam During the Time of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: day and invited Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA), Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA). When the time arrived for salaah, Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) stepped forward to lead the salaah when Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) said to him, "Step back because the owner of the house is entitled to leading the salaah." "Is that so, O Ibn Mas'ood?" Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) asked. When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) confirmed what Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) said, Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) stepped back. Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed says, "They then put me forward (to lead the salaah) whereas I was just a slave. Nevertheless, I led them in the salaah." [^1]

Hadhrat Naafi reports, "People had stood up for salaah in a Masjid in a district of Madinah where Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) had a property. The Imaam of the Masjid was a slave and when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) came for the salaah, the Imaam requested him to lead the salaah. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) declined saying, 'You have a greater right to lead the salaah in your Masjid.' The Imaam then proceeded to lead the salaah." [^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Handhala (RA) narrates, "We were in the house of Qais bin Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) with a group of Sahabah (RA) when we told him to lead the salaah. 'I cannot do so (in the presence of men better than I),' he submitted. I said, 'Rasulullaah ﷺ said that a man has a greater right to the front of his bed, to the front of his animal and to lead the salaah in his house.' He then instructed one of his slaves who went forward and led the salaah." [^3]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) Performs Salaah Behind Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) in his house

Hadhrat Alqama narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once visited Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) at his house. When the time for salaah arrived, Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) said to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA), "Go forward (to lead the salaah), O Abu Abdur Rahmaan because you are elder and more knowledgeable than I." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) replied, "You rather go forward because I have come your house and your Masjid. You therefore have a greater right." Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) then stepped forward and removed his shoes (and led the salaah). After he had completed, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) asked, "What was your reason for removing your shoes? Are you on the Waadi Muqaddas (where Hadhrat Moosa (AS) was when he had to remove his shoes)?" [^4]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said to Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA), "O Abu Moosa!
